name: Zane Stenning
title: Co-founder
bio: Zane is a medical doctor and co-founder of Mia Healthcare, a South African company building what he believes will be Africa’s first full-stack dental platform, spanning patients, practitioners, medical devices, infrastructure, finance and technology. Having seen talented clinicians working within broken public healthcare systems, he co-founded Mia in 2021 to make quality dental care scalable and accessible. The business has built locally manufactured clear aligners, mobile dental clinics, practice software and a growing DSO platform. In the past year, revenue grew over 10x and the ecosystem raised $4m USD.
